description: Malaysia Airlines Enrich Points and Elite Points for a Malaysia Airlines ticket. Enrich Points = the fare in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR: base fare plus fuel surcharge and administration charge, no government taxes, whole ticket) x tier rate (Blue 1.5, Silver 1.8, Gold 2.2, Platinum 2.5), rounded down. Malaysia Airlines converts a fare in another currency itself and does not publish the rate, so give the MYR amount. Elite Points are fixed per flight by distance zone and cabin (Economy 1 to 10, Business Class 2 to 15, Business Suite 3 to 20), worked out only for a flight to or from Kuala Lumpur (KUL): Malaysia Airlines does not say how another flight is zoned, so it is shown as not worked out. Progress toward Silver (35), Gold (70) and Platinum (140) Elite Points in a calendar year; ep is the Elite Points so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them), the ISO country codes of its two airports, from and to IATA airport codes (needed for Elite Points) and optionally its own cabin (Y, C or S). Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in MYR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

cabin.description: Cabin. Y = Economy; C = Business Class; S = Business Suite. Business Suite is the A350 suite product.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Malaysia Airlines's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights. No price is needed with creditTo.

ep.description: Elite Points you have this calendar year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

price.description: Ticket fare in MYR (whole trip) in MYR. In Malaysian Ringgit: the base fare plus the fuel surcharge and administration charge, without government taxes and fees, for the whole ticket. Malaysia Airlines converts a fare paid in another currency itself and does not publish the rate. Required unless creditTo is given.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional cabin (Y, C, S) for a flight in another cabin than the ticket's; optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

cabin.description: This flight's cabin, when it differs from the ticket's cabin.

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

tier.description: Your Enrich tier. BL = Blue (1.5 per MYR 1); SL = Silver (1.8 per MYR 1); GD = Gold (2.2 per MYR 1); PT = Platinum (2.5 per MYR 1). Sets the Enrich Points per MYR 1. Silver is oneworld Ruby, Gold is Sapphire and Platinum is Emerald.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way for Elite Points. The fare above is for the whole ticket either way.
